notes: The judgment is $8,000 larger than the complaint asked for, and the reason is traceable on the record. JobsOhio's memorandum in support of default judgment opens: "JobsOhio filed this Complaint on June 11, 2026, seeking recovery of $25,000.00 in grant funds pursuant to Defendant's breach of a Grant Agreement entered into with JobsOhio." The complaint says $17,000.00 five times, including in its prayer, and never says $25,000.00 except as the ceiling of the award. $25,000.00 is the amount the agreement authorized, not the amount JobsOhio pleaded it paid out. The court signed the entry at $25,00
